question: As at 31 March 2023, how much premium had been earned so far in calendar year 2023?
final_text:
Premium earned in calendar 2023 up to 31 March 2023, as known at that date, is about **£5,060,696**.

I took every premium transaction booked on or before 31 March 2023 and earned its written premium pro rata by day over its cover period, counting only the days falling in 1 January to 31 March 2023. Cancellation rows earn over their own effective-to-expiry period, as the schema specifies. Transactions booked after 31 March 2023 are excluded, which is the knowledge-date rule for this valuation.

ANSWER: 5060695.55

input.query: SELECT txn_type, COUNT(*) n, MIN(effective_date) min_eff, MAX(cover_end_date) max_end, MIN(booked_date) min_booked, MAX(booked_date) max_booked, SUM(CASE WHEN effective_date=cover_end_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_len, SUM(CASE WHEN booked_date>DATE '2023-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) booked_after FROM premium_txn GROUP BY txn_type

SELECT SUM(written_premium * (LEAST(cover_end_date, DATE '2023-04-01') - GREATEST(effective_date, DATE '2023-01-01'))::DOUBLE / (cover_end_date - effective_date)) AS earned_q1_2023 FROM premium_txn WHERE booked_date <= DATE '2023-03-31' AND cover_end_date > effective_date AND effective_date < DATE '2023-04-01' AND cover_end_date > DATE '2023-01-01'
